:::{#exm-nested-re-cov}
#### Correlations in the cooperative trial

With the estimated variance components from @exm-coop,
$\sigma_L^2 = 0.0602$, $\sigma_B^2 = 0.0054$, and $\sigma^2 = 0.0063$,
@thm-nested-re-cov gives the variance of one measurement:

$$
\ba
\Var{Y_{ijk}}
&= 0.0602 + 0.0054 + 0.0063
&& \text{(first case of the theorem)}
\\
&= 0.0719
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

Dividing each covariance by this variance gives the correlations:

- two replicates of the same batch:
  $(0.0602 + 0.0054) / 0.0719 = 0.0656 / 0.0719 \approx 0.912$;
- two batches from the same laboratory:
  $0.0602 / 0.0719 \approx 0.837$;
- measurements from different laboratories: $0$.

Measurements from the same laboratory are highly correlated
even when they come from batches analyzed a month apart.
:::
